implementation: Flutter AnimationController / TweenSequence; no prerendered GIF; time-based relative to completion result screen entry
start_condition: Both basic+application learning flow finished; reward grant resolved idempotently; no active result modal; permission for animation.

sequence_ms.name: confetti_burst
sequence_ms.property: gold/gray sprites emit outward from left/right of character; slight fall; fade to 0.6 then hold

sequence_ms.name: xp_reveal
sequence_ms.when: all, including +0 but do not show award as new on review

sequence_ms.name: xp_progress_tween
sequence_ms.property: animate progress previous fraction→new fraction, from authoritative before/after XP data
sequence_ms.on_level_up: handle progress wrap as a separate sequence when threshold crossed

sequence_ms.name: idle_result_hold
sequence_ms.property: no further looping; show screen unchanged until CTA tap

sprite_configuration.repetition: small finite bursts only, no endless particle loop

sound_coordination.policy: No automatic new completion sound. Wait until O/X popup and its audio have completed or been dismissed, then start completion animation. Never overlap existing judgement SFX; avoid duplicate play on repeated enter.

accessibility.reduce_motion: Disable bounce/rotation/confetti movement. Show static character, reward and final gauge immediately; optional short 100ms fade only.
accessibility.announce: Speak state title and awarded XP once on page enter.

lifecycle.on_page_reenter: do not issue a second reward; replay small visual intro optional once at most per user action
lifecycle.on_cta: navigation only after reward state persisted; do not auto_navigate

level_transition_condition: Do NOT infer threshold from preview; threshold from actual user level policy
flutter_suggested_implementation: AnimatedOpacity + SlideTransition + ScaleTransition + RotationTransition + AnimatedBuilder; Stack/Positioned for decor; TweenAnimationBuilder<double> for progress
